title: [CQ-M03a] Frozen workload snapshot contract
description: Objective: Independently land the small test-only data contract and safe reset/materialization primitive used by CQ-M03's four workload categories. Deliverable: new packages/moe-daemon/src/benchmarks/workloadSnapshot.ts and packages/moe-daemon/src/benchmarks/workloadSnapshot.test.ts. Frozen corpus contract (version 1): each workload has a unique category-prefixed id, category (maintenance/defect/refactor/non-routine), full startingCommit 35cf53c8444ebe1ca27e68bfbe8c5ca4896bac71, named repo source provenance, intendedBehavior/task instructions, deterministic snapshot digest over a documented sorted-path/UTF-8-byte encoding, initialFiles and separately held-out assessmentFiles (relative portable paths mapped to immutable UTF-8 strings), and explicit assessment rubric criteria/coverage tags. assessmentFiles contains executable independent black-box acceptance tests; it must not be copied into the coding snapshot. Include bounded reviewable Node ESM fixture source adaptations grounded in original Moe source, not twenty renamed toy cases, and label any reduced/adapted snapshot provenance honestly. No reference solution in coding inputs. Every case has a concrete original-state failure/required change and unchanged-acceptance positive and adversarial-negative controls; no agent judge/price/network dependency. The shared materializer owns only newly created os.tmpdir directories and offers fresh reset by new snapshot creation, never an arbitrary target root or Git reset/worktree operation. Implement reusable strict validation, deterministic digesting and fresh snapshot materialization; no dataset authoring or benchmark execution/outcome ranking in this slice. A fresh snapshot is an immutable base plus bytes of the fixture overlay, not a claim the reduced fixture equals a whole repository checkout. Read-only commit provenance may be captured during authoring; tests must also work in source archives without .git. Verification: cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/benchmarks/workloadSnapshot.test.ts
definitionOfDone: A strict local test-data contract validates portable safe unique paths, immutable full-commit/source provenance, separate coding/assessment inputs and stable content digests; rejects malformed/conflicting/missing data.

Fresh materialization/reset writes only newly owned temporary directories, never accepts an arbitrary destination, never writes the source checkout, and excludes all held-out assessment material from coding inputs.
Tests cover determinism, repeated/concurrent resets, cleanup ownership, malformed metadata, traversal/absolute/Windows paths and symlink escapes, plus an unchanged user-tree sentinel.
Fresh cd packages/moe-daemon && npx vitest run src/benchmarks/workloadSnapshot.test.ts exits 0 with output supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits or Git-write commands; wrappers own landing. Preserve all peer/pre-existing dirty bytes.
Frozen benchmark/test scaffolding only; do not alter production behavior, enable verified-local, or claim VM/isolation certification.
Do not edit sibling category datasets/tests, the shared contract after it lands, or the M03 assembler; use explicit dependency updates for any contract change.

implementationPlan.description: Contract, validation and digests in a new packages/moe-daemon/src/benchmarks/workloadSnapshot.ts (LF, Node ESM; runtime imports only node built-ins via `import fs from 'node:fs'` etc. plus ../util/errors.js; test-only scaffolding that no production module imports; Node >=18 so no String.prototype.isWellFormed). Module doc comment: frozen corpus contract v1, the exact digest framing, the assessment convention, and that a snapshot is the reduced fixture overlay for the immutable base commit, never a whole-repository checkout. Export: WORKLOAD_CONTRACT_VERSION = 1; FROZEN_STARTING_COMMIT = '35cf53c8444ebe1ca27e68bfbe8c5ca4896bac71'; SOURCE_REPOSITORY = 'github.com/yaront1111/Moe-s-Tavern'; frozen WORKLOAD_CATEGORIES ['maintenance','defect','refactor','non-routine']; frozen CORPUS_COVERAGE_TAGS ['reusable-helper','stale-positive-context','stale-negative-context','changed-caller','changed-requirements','recipe-mismatch'] (shared spelling for M03b-e and the M03 assembler; validation accepts any kebab tag); WORKLOAD_CANDIDATE_ROOT_ENV = 'MOE_WORKLOAD_CANDIDATE_ROOT' (assessment *.test.mjs files run with `node --test` from the assessment root and locate the candidate through it); named limit constants; types WorkloadCategory, WorkloadFiles, WorkloadSource, WorkloadCriterion, WorkloadRubric, Workload (all readonly). Portable-path rule (one private validator, used for both file maps and source.paths; deliberately stricter and platform-independent, unlike util/affectedFiles' lenient normalizer and platform pathKey): string, NFC, '/'-separated, relative, no empty/'.'/'..' segments, no leading/trailing '/', no backslash, drive or UNC prefix, no <>:"|?* or control/DEL chars, no segment with a trailing dot or space or a leading space, no Windows device names (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, CONIN$, CONOUT$, COM0-9/LPT0-9 incl. superscript 1-3, with any extension, case-insensitive), no '.git' segment (case-insensitive); <=160 UTF-8 bytes, <=12 segments, segment <=64 UTF-8 bytes. Within a map, keys must be unique after NFC + toLowerCase, and no key may be both a file and a directory prefix of another key. Contents: strings that round-trip through UTF-8 (Buffer.from(s,'utf8').toString('utf8') === s); <=64 files, <=256 KiB per file, <=1 MiB per map. digestFiles(files): validates, sorts entries by Buffer.compare of UTF-8 path bytes, and hashes SHA-256 over UTF-8 'moe-workload-files-v1\0' + u32be(count) + for each entry u32be(pathBytes)+path+u32be(contentBytes)+content; returns 'sha256:' + 64 lowercase hex. validateWorkload(raw): plain object (prototype Object.prototype or null) with EXACTLY the Workload keys (an unknown key such as 'solution' is rejected); checks contractVersion, category, an id matching `${category}-[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*` within 80 chars, startingCommit === FROZEN_STARTING_COMMIT, source {repository === SOURCE_REPOSITORY, 1-16 unique portable paths, adaptation verbatim|reduced|adapted, non-blank note <=1000}, intendedBehavior non-blank <=4000, both maps non-empty with paths disjoint after folding and no identical content across them, at least one '*.test.mjs' assessment file, rubric {1-16 criteria with unique kebab ids <=64 and non-blank descriptions <=1000, each id occurring in some *.test.mjs assessment content; 1-16 unique kebab coverageTags <=64}, and digests in 'sha256:' form equal to digestFiles of their map (mismatch message includes the computed digest). Returns a NEW deep-frozen copy with null-prototype frozen file maps. validateWorkloads(raw): array of 1-64, each validated, rejecting duplicate ids (case-insensitive) and duplicate snapshotDigest; returns a frozen array. digestWorkload(raw): validate, then SHA-256 over UTF-8 'moe-workload-v1\0' + JSON.stringify of a positional array [contractVersion, id, category, startingCommit, [repository, paths, adaptation, note], intendedBehavior, snapshotDigest, assessmentDigest, criteria as [id, description] pairs, coverageTags] in authored order. Error handling: every failure is invalidInput('workload.<field path>', reason); never echo file contents, and echo a path only once it passed the length bound (JSON.stringify), otherwise describe it by index.

Owned temporary snapshots in the same module. Export interface WorkloadSnapshotHandle { readonly kind: 'coding' | 'assessment'; readonly workloadId: string; readonly root: string; readonly digest: string; dispose(): Promise<void> } plus createCodingSnapshot(raw) (initialFiles only, never any assessment material), createAssessmentSnapshot(raw) (assessmentFiles only, in its own separate root for the later evaluator) and readSnapshotFiles(handle). Creation: validateWorkload FIRST (no IO for invalid input); root = realpath of fs.promises.mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'moe-workload-coding-' | 'moe-workload-assessment-')) - no caller-supplied destination exists in the API; record lstat(root, { bigint: true }) dev/ino; write entries in the same UTF-8 byte order with fs.promises.mkdir(parent, { recursive: true }) and fs.promises.writeFile(full, content, { encoding: 'utf8', flag: 'wx' }) (exclusive create, never overwrites or follows a final-component link). Error handling on any IO failure: best-effort fs.promises.rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true }), then rethrow the original error with its code; if removal also fails, throw an Error naming both codes and the leftover temp root. Reset is ONLY a new create call: nothing is reset in place, and there is no Git checkout/reset/worktree operation. The handle is Object.freeze'd; ownership lives in a module-private WeakMap (handle -> { root, dev, ino, disposed, pending }), and dispose uses that captured state, never `this`, so it cannot be redirected. dispose: memoize the in-flight promise; when already disposed or the root is gone, resolve; lstat(root, { bigint: true }) must be a real directory (not a symlink/junction) with the recorded dev/ino, else throw notAllowed('dispose snapshot', ...) and remove nothing; then fs.promises.rm(root, { recursive: true, force: true }) (rm removes links inside as links and never follows them, junctions included on Windows). readSnapshotFiles(handle): reject handles missing from the WeakMap or already disposed; verify the root identity as above; walk with readdir withFileTypes, refusing symlinks/junctions and special entries with a bounded error naming the relative path; open files with O_RDONLY | (fs.constants.O_NOFOLLOW ?? 0), fstat-bound to the per-file limit before reading, decode with new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true }); depth <=32 and <=4096 entries; return a frozen null-prototype map keyed by '/'-joined relative paths (empty directories are not represented; a non-portable candidate path is returned and later rejected by digestFiles). Iterate with the focused file only: `npx vitest run src/benchmarks/workloadSnapshot.test.ts` in the isolated Linux copy until green.
implementationPlan.note:
Owned temp snapshots added in the same module.
- **API:** createCodingSnapshot / createAssessmentSnapshot / readSnapshotFiles plus WorkloadSnapshotHandle / WorkloadSnapshotKind.
- **Creation:** validates first with no IO; mkdtemp under os.tmpdir() then realpath; records bigint dev/ino; writes in UTF-8 byte order with flag 'wx'.
- **Failure cleanup:** best-effort rm, then rethrows the original code. If rm also fails, throws an Error naming both codes and the leftover root.
- **Ownership:** a WeakMap, with dispose closed over the captured state (never `this`). The dispose promise is memoized and reset after a refusal so a retry re-verifies. Refusals are NOT_ALLOWED when the root is a link or has a different dev/ino.
- **Reads:** no link following (readdir withFileTypes, O_NOFOLLOW), size bound checked before reading, fatal TextDecoder with ignoreBOM so a leading U+FEFF round-trips.

implementationPlan.note:
I ran one adversarial review over both new files. It found three things, all fixed with tests:
1. **Case folding.** toLowerCase missed the NTFS upcase aliases (dotless i to I, long s to S), so '.gıt/config' could alias '.git' and 'i.txt' plus 'ı.txt' collide on Windows. Fixed with `foldCase` = toUpperCase().toLowerCase(), now used for collisions, separation, source paths, device names and '.git'.
2. **Criterion mentions.** The plain substring check let a short id like 'converts' count as mentioned inside 'converts-backslashes'. It now requires a whole-token match.
3. **Long text.** readText now checks length before trim.

Red: against the pre-fix module, 3 of 141 tests failed. Fresh gate after the changes (new copy /tmp/moe-m03a-gate.TNvrCB, sha256 identical to the working tree: ts 7736a39b…, test 3561c2f1…):

- the repeat run exit 0, 141/141 passed;
- tsc --noEmit --incremental false exit 0;

Checked and clean:
- (a) paths are re-validated before path.join; mkdtemp is the only root; WeakMap ownership plus dev/ino rejects forged or swapped roots; dispose ignores `this`; concurrent dispose is memoized.
- (b) unknown keys, overlapping paths (after folding) and identical copied content are all rejected.
- (c) digests are length-prefixed and sorted by UTF-8 bytes; digestWorkload covers all 11 fields.
- (d) every failure happens before IO, with bounded messages that never echo contents.
- (e)/(f) only node built-ins plus util/errors; no production import (grep); no Git/.moe writes; no forbidden tokens.

Theoretical, not fixed:
- a same-user race that swaps the root or a file between the identity check and readdir/rm. rm never follows a root link; Windows has no O_NOFOLLOW. Real isolation is the VM's job, and this slice does not claim it.
- semantic solution leakage (paraphrased answers) cannot be machine-checked; category QA owns it.
- reading during an in-flight dispose rejects with a raw fs error.

My temp copies and scratch were removed; the shared Linux install was left untouched.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
- **Reuse util/affectedFiles (normalizeAffectedFile, pathKey)**: rejected. It is a lenient normalizer: it converts backslashes, strips './' and drops empty segments, and it folds case only on win32/darwin. A frozen portable contract must reject non-canonical forms and fold case on every platform, so the module gets one strict, documented path validator.
- **Generic materializer with a caller-chosen destination, or reset in place via Git**: forbidden by the task. Reset is only a new mkdtemp snapshot, and the API has no destination parameter.
- **One combined coding+assessment directory**: rejected. It risks leakage. Two separate roots are used instead, and assessments find the candidate through WORKLOAD_CANDIDATE_ROOT_ENV.
- **Benchmark runner or outcome scoring**: out of scope. The single spawn test only proves the assessment convention so the four category tasks can rely on it.
- **Pinning digests as literals**: chosen because it freezes bytes. Any edit without a digest update fails validation, and the mismatch message prints the computed digest for authors.
- **Extra exports for downstream tasks**: added because M03b-e and the M03 assembler may not edit this contract after it lands. The additions are validateWorkloads (duplicate id/snapshot checks), digestWorkload (per-case identity covering provenance and rubric), CORPUS_COVERAGE_TAGS (shared spelling) and readSnapshotFiles (safe read-back for reset verification).
- **Fields for corrected/plausible-wrong variants**: deliberately left out of the contract. They are test-only bytes in each category's test file, never part of a workload object.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- **Location**: src/benchmarks/ does not exist yet. Vitest includes src/**/*.test.ts, and tsc includes src/ but excludes tests, so the new module compiles into dist while staying unused by production code.
- **Safe to add a directory**: no existing test walks all of src (stateModules.test.ts reads only src/state).
- **Engines**: package.json engines say node >=18. TextDecoder fatal, fs.promises.rm, mkdtemp and withFileTypes are all available there; String.prototype.isWellFormed is not.
- **Error helpers** (util/errors.ts): invalidInput(field, reason) gives '[INVALID_INPUT] Invalid <field>: <reason>'; notAllowed(operation, reason) gives NOT_ALLOWED.
- **Imports**: daemon modules use `import fs from 'node:fs'` (affectedFiles.ts), so `vi.spyOn(fs.promises, 'writeFile' | 'mkdtemp')` intercepts the module's calls.
- **Literal normalization**: template literals normalize CRLF/CR to LF in both cooked and raw values. Category datasets therefore keep stable digests whatever line endings their .ts files are checked out with; explicit escapes are still needed for an intended \r.
- **Frozen commit**: 35cf53c8444ebe1ca27e68bfbe8c5ca4896bac71 exists, and origin is github.com/yaront1111/Moe-s-Tavern.

planningNotes.risks:
- **Data loss**: dispose uses rm recursive. It must act only on the WeakMap-recorded root after a bigint dev/ino lstat match, never through a link and never on a caller-supplied path. Tests prove a junction to a sentinel survives.
- **Windows**: symlinks need admin, so tests create directory links with type 'junction'. lstat reports junctions as symbolic links. Keep relative paths under 160 bytes so tmp prefix plus path stays below MAX_PATH. Reject device names, trailing dots/spaces, ':' streams and case collisions even when running on Linux.
- **macOS**: os.tmpdir() is a symlinked /var path. Store and compare realpaths, and reject non-NFC names that HFS/APFS would alias.
- **Leakage**: an unknown top-level key (e.g. 'solution') is rejected, the two path sets are disjoint and identical cross-map contents are rejected. Semantic solution leakage cannot be machine-checked; category QA owns it.
- **Determinism**: sort by UTF-8 bytes, not JS string order. Length-prefix every field so framing is unambiguous. Pin with an independently built framing test plus a literal vector.
- **Spawn smoke test**: pass NODE_OPTIONS='' and a 60s timeout, and use process.execPath. Keep it the single execution test.
- **Hygiene**: tests must dispose every handle and remove sentinels so os.tmpdir() is left clean.
- **Rails**: global forbiddenPatterns include the dunder-proto token, so never write it. Make no production, daemon, MCP or schema edits, no Git or .moe writes, and no benchmark, VM or rollout claims. Preserve the shared tree's peer and pre-existing dirty bytes and report only the two new files.
- **Token rails**: focused runs only, no subagent fan-out, and one final gate.

CQ-M03a frozen workload snapshot contract v1. Two new test-only files with no production import, no daemon/MCP/schema change and no Git/.moe writes: packages/moe-daemon/src/benchmarks/workloadSnapshot.ts and workloadSnapshot.test.ts.

- Constants: WORKLOAD_CONTRACT_VERSION, FROZEN_STARTING_COMMIT (full 35cf53c8…), SOURCE_REPOSITORY, WORKLOAD_CATEGORIES, CORPUS_COVERAGE_TAGS, WORKLOAD_CANDIDATE_ROOT_ENV, WORKLOAD_LIMITS.
- Readonly types.
- validateWorkload (exact keys, deep-frozen copy) and validateWorkloads (rejects duplicate ids and duplicate snapshots).
- digestFiles: SHA-256 with length-prefixed framing, in UTF-8 path byte order, and documented.
- digestWorkload: covers all 11 fields.
- createCodingSnapshot / createAssessmentSnapshot: fresh mkdtemp roots only, no destination parameter; reset means creating a new snapshot; a write failure cleans up and keeps the original error code.
- readSnapshotFiles: never follows links, and is bounded.

Ownership lives in a WeakMap with bigint dev/ino identity. dispose ignores `this`, is memoized, and returns NOT_ALLOWED for a swapped or linked root.

Paths follow one strict portable rule: reject absolute, drive, UNC, backslash, dot segments, reserved, control and invisible characters, device names, .git and GIT~1, non-NFC names, trailing dots or spaces, and NTFS-aware case collisions or file/directory conflicts. Assessment files stay separate: overlapping paths or copied content are rejected, at least one *.test.mjs is required, and each criterion id must appear as a whole token.

The sample is reduced from normalizeAffectedFile and honestly labeled a contract sample. The assessment convention is verified by one node --test smoke: the original fails, the fixed candidate passes, the plausible-wrong one fails.
